_notes: Edit the paths and tracksets here, nothing else needs touching. Run scripts/00_check_env.py (pbs/00_check_env.pbs) first.
weights: pretrained AlphaGenome weights. A .safetensors/.pth/.pt file is accepted. CHECK this path on Katana.

tracksets: regex (case-insensitive) matched against biosample_name | ontology_curie | track_name | assay_title of the MOUSE tracks. Matching tracks are averaged. Run 00_check_env to see what exists and edit the patterns if a set matches nothing.
perturb.reps: random replicates per stochastic edit. Total forward passes per site = 1 + 3*reps.shuffle + 3*reps.random + 3*reps.dinuc + 2*reps.flank + 1 (core).
